theorem.domain: Canonical square_graph(L), L>=3, 0<p<1, finite real h, signed interior charge Q and binary occupancy logical sector a.
theorem.charge_potential: psi(x,y)=x+y; M(Q)=sum_{v interior} psi_v Q_v; B(Q_rough)=sum_{v rough} psi_v Q_v
theorem.identity: Z_a(Q;p,h)=c^E exp[h M(Q)] sum_{Q_rough} exp[h B(Q_rough)] Z_a(Q,Q_rough;p_eff,0)
theorem.sector_ratio: Z_0(Q;p,h)/Z_1(Q;p,h) is the ratio of the two rough-charge generating functions at p_eff; common c^E exp[h M(Q)] cancels.
theorem.proof: For j=0, c(1-p_eff)=1-p; for j=+-1, c(p_eff/2)exp(hj)=p exp(hj)/(2cosh h). Multiply over edges and use sum_e j_e=sum_v psi_v Q_v by incidence summation. Group exact weights by measured Q, rough Q and logical sector.

counterfamily.domain: Every canonical square L>=3; fixed nonzero h; compare two admissible configurations with the same measured interior Q=0.
counterfamily.zero_current: j_e=0 for all edges, B=0, logical sector 0.
counterfamily.row_current: j_e=+1 on one complete left-to-right horizontal row, zero elsewhere; B=L-1, logical sector 1.
counterfamily.rough_fugacity_ratio: exp[h(L-1)] relative to the zero current; the larger of the forward and inverse ratios is exp[|h|(L-1)].
counterfamily.conclusion: No L-independent two-sided pointwise bound on rough-boundary fugacity exists for fixed h!=0 on the admitted current space, even at measured Q=0. This does not bound or separate the summed sector posteriors or Bayes risk.

claim_boundary: The identity is finite-volume exact. The counterfamily rejects only pointwise uniform rough-fugacity control; averaged sector-generating-function balance and fixed-h thermodynamic decoding remain open.
